messages:
sophia: quick heads-up — Acme (POC) is pushing to sign if we can guarantee: tenant-level routing parity + immutable audit logs + 99th p50 latency within current Dedicated profile. they want this in the initial Dedicated launch. can we scope acceptance criteria by EOD? :eyes:

jamal: TL;DR: routing parity we can target with a minimal adapter layer. audit logs are trickier (retention + immutable store + KMS). rough estimate: routing parity = 1 sprint, audit logs = 2 sprints + infra changes. latency target might need a quantized model or smaller batch defaults.

rachel: Acme pricing is time-sensitive — they said if we can commit to those gates we move from eval to contract in 2 weeks. sales needs clear yes/no and tradeoffs.

devon: from design/security POV, the audit log UX is small (log viewer + download). the bigger ask is legal/regulatory: WORM-style retention or HSM key rotation? we need spec.

alan: technical note: immutable audit logs implies append-only store + signed entries. we can use existing S3 + S3 Object Lock for WORM and envelope encryption with KMS. integration effort ~3 dev-weeks (infra + api).

jamal: okay. propose acceptance criteria draft below. please react with :+1: if okay or add quick changes.

sophia: yes please — put it in bullet checklist.

jamal: Acceptance checklist:
- tenant routing parity: inbound routing rules and per-tenant routing config support the same routing policies as Hosted (weighted pools, fallback) and pass parity tests (test-suite run) :white_check_mark:
- audit logs: append-only log with exportable signed entries, retention configurable, S3 Object Lock or equivalent enabled, KMS-integrated encryption, tamper-evidence tests :white_check_mark:
- latency SLOs: 95th <= current Dedicated baseline, 99th within 1.5x baseline for initial rollout, documented fallback model to lower-cost variant when under heavy load
- rollout gating: canary on 5% tenants, health checks + automated rollback

rachel: sales note: if we accept 99th within 1.5x baseline it should be in contract language as "initial performance commitment" with a roadmap to tighten. clients want numbers.

devon: also add privacy note: ensure logs redact PII by default. we need a toggle for full payload logging (opt-in).

alan: good call. add to checklist: default PII redaction + optional full-log opt-in via config.

sophia: this is shaping up. two tradeoffs we need to call out for exec: 1) commit to audit log permanence (higher infra cost + compliance) vs. delayed contract, 2) tight latency SLO vs. longer dev time (quantize/optimizations).

jamal: for estimates: routing parity (2 FE/BE devs) 2 weeks, audit logs (2 infra + 1 eng) 4 weeks, latency tuning (quantize experiments) 3 weeks parallel. ops will need runbook updates.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of routing-adapter branch succeeded on staging at 1768504370 :rocket:

rachel: Sales asks for a short EOD note to Acme with the acceptance checklist + timeline (best-effort dates). I can draft if you approve checklist.

sophia: approve. jamal — final ask: mark any "must-haves" vs "nice-to-haves" in checklist. then we send.

jamal: updated — must-haves = routing parity, audit logs (WORM + KMS), PII redaction default. nice-to-haves = tightened 99th target (<1.2x) and UI export enhancements. sending updated checklist to thread.

alan: I'll start infra spike for S3 Object Lock + KMS patterns tomorrow.

devon: I'll mock minimal log viewer for canary tenants.

rachel: I'll send draft to Acme and set expectation: contract ready if must-haves delivered in 6 weeks, with roadmap milestones for tightening perf.

sophia: perfect. we'll re-sync Wed morning for status. thanks all. :pray:
